name: Boon of Y'shaarj grants max health from Intellect at both ranks (#965)
contract: Spell.dbc 560080 (rank 1) and 561335 (rank 2) each carry two SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_MAX_MANA_FROM_STAT (328) effects on STAT_INTELLECT (EffectMiscValueB=3): effect 0 with EffectMiscValue=POWER_MANA (0) and effect 1 with EffectMiscValue=POWER_HEALTH (-2), both EffectBasePoints 199/399 resolving (DieSides=1) to 200/400, matching the tooltip "Increases the amount of mana and now health per point of Intellect by 200%/400%." Under owner ruling Cultist Q-cu-24 / O-16 (2026-11-25, Cultist ADR 0021), Boon of Y'shaarj applies +200% (rank 1) and +400% (rank 2) to Cultist Intellect-to-mana scaling (45/75 mana per point above 20, 3/5 for the first 20) and to a base of 0.25 health per Intellect point (0.75 health/Int at rank 1, 1.25 health/Int at rank 2, 0 without the talent). Rank 2's max_health gain over baseline therefore stands in a 5/3 ratio (1.25 / 0.75 = 1.6667) to rank 1's, bounded [1.60, 1.75] to allow integer truncation while excluding the old 2.0 ratio.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Rank 1's mana-from-Intellect half still works (regression guard)
Rank 1's health-from-Intellect half now grants max health (was 0 before the fix)
Rank 2's health-from-Intellect half also grants max health
Rank 2 (1.25 HP/Int) grants 5/3 of rank 1's (0.75 HP/Int) max health bonus
